arms.baseline: pinned symbolic grammar, vendor/generic_solver.py SHA-256 37084696d0040d26ce08fc3d18e0cea20f78436152abb4ba59b9a24add01e769 (upstream commit 7a89d10f82cb5d6767a35c8db9017437cd0b3081), run through the v1 instrumented wrapper
arms.feedback: identical seeds and identical random-restart sampler; additionally, after a candidate fails on a training pair, derives child programs from that pair's cell residuals and tries them before the sampler
arms.no_feedback: new object-level generator: first-demonstration seeds, then seeded random restarts over the SAME parameter family; never reads residuals to build candidates

budgets_per_task.accounting: candidates = programs evaluated on training pairs; checks = single-pair applications. Same caps for every arm. Wall-clock and primitive-step counts are reported separately; caps do not prove equal CPU time.

claims_not_made: No claim of novelty beyond the narrow residual-to-program derivations listed
disclosures: Solver, fixtures and harness are written by an Anthropic model (Claude) at the user's request.

The operator set was chosen from general ARC knowledge, which includes familiarity with public ARC-1 tasks that also appear in the ARC-AGI-2 training split; the dev sample is therefore NOT held out from the designer's or any model's prior knowledge.
No task-specific prompts, solutions or hints are used at inference. No LLM, network or randomness beyond the recorded seed at inference.
experiment: MERENVAY E-RNA v2: object-level residual-feedback probe, development sample

metrics.inference_rule: No significance claim. If fewer than 10 tasks are discordant between feedback and no_feedback, report counts only and state that the comparison is uninformative.
primary: paired discordance feedback vs no_feedback (tasks solved by one arm only)
secondary: accepted programs whose provenance includes a residual-derived step

program_family.object_definition: connected components, 4-connectivity same color for recolor; 8-connectivity multicolor non-background for crop
residual_derivations: post-composed color map from functional predicted->expected color change
recolor_objects_by_attribute mapping from per-object consistent target colors

run_policy: Solver code is developed and unit-tested on procedurally built synthetic fixtures only. Exactly ONE scored run on these 40 tasks. Crash-only fixes after that run are allowed and must be logged as deviations; any other change makes a new version that needs a new, fresh sample.
selection_rule: first 40 IDs of the 1000 data/training IDs, sorted bytewise (LC_ALL=C), taken from the git tree listing only (no blobs read)
separation_from_v1: The 24 ARC-AGI-2 public-evaluation tasks of the v1 probe are never used here for development or tuning.
